folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B384: mechanism-led ability and feature scope
folds.body:
This entire queue, F1–F4/O1/O2/O4/O5 rows and A1–A5 extension were read. Preserve playable weak starts with an actual in-world reason, accessible support and consequential growth, without making a fixed first-hour win a gate. Derived description reads actual body/marks/titles/knowledge rather than inventing or storing a second past. Hidden source or identity remains undisclosed until its observer route. Faculty, technique, source assignment, current support, permission and public rank are different facts; a power name supplies no behavior.

The sentence requiring every ability to grow while away is a proposed overreach. Current AD16/AD52 require actual eligible mechanisms, workers, supports, clocks and results. Some abilities can be useful through choices or active use without offline growth; paused or unsupported contexts produce nothing by a blanket idle entitlement. AD51 permits a first useful shared seam, with another world validating or revising it. A second style legitimately needing an adapter or core correction does not fail a universal no-new-file test. Source-qualified canonical powers and original demonstrations retain different evidence; no book fact follows from a descriptor.

O3's then-skipped Glasshouse depth, lowviewport target, actor counts, writer/dependency flags and one-slice order remain dated. Current PROJECT governs build order and current desktop targets. Derived views and family records need not wait for unrelated stock work when their actual consumers are ready; the old O4-before-O5a dependency is scoped advice. [Recovered-detail coverage](../title-rules-implementation-2026-10-21/COVERAGE.md) qualifies O2a's later vest bounty; it does not close chemistry/energy/power lifetimes or spatial situations. No new runtime, agents, source acquisition or user gate is created here (AD42).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B384: exact loan flow and later presentation
folds.body:
The complete O4 checkpoint was read. Keep player ownership, current companion holder and lawful loan in the existing custody state rather than a second stock store. The single rebuilt log handoff/return proves its declared fixture, exact native bag delta and loan save/reload/literal Import. It does not certify every favorite/equipped/borrowed/stale path in browser, native reference parity, nonsimulation companions, gifts, companion-to-chest direct moves or realm passage consent. Pure/source tests and an actual transfer are different proof types.

The original crowded Hand/Take-back presentation is qualified by the later [D1 G1 Stock/Companion resume](../ui-detail-2026-10-25/RESUME.md), which names item kinds and shared action-row spacing at its own targets. That later branch UI proof is not a new custody or integration check. Planned seam naming and delivered function naming retain their dates; no missing-API defect is inferred from the different labels. Old1366 captures and uncommitted output are historical. Current AD42 makes human taste feedback optional; no fresh browser/reference/app verification or transfer was performed.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B384: residence, workers, obligations and source lifetimes
folds.body:
The full home, [household-life](household-life/CHECKPOINT.md) and [fortunes/trust](../household-fortunes-wiring-2026-10-23/CHECKPOINT.md) checkpoints were reviewed together. Preserve residence rights, access and occupancy separately from legal title/rank or permission to sell communal fixtures. Natural nest/burrow/shelter work need not purchase a house; incomplete construction is not housing. Played rain, structural condition, material custody, native reservations and actual workers remain different owners. Packing a portable shelter cannot teleport goods or duplicate deployed support. Helpers cannot double-book or mint wages.

Staff rest/leave and tutoring have real readiness, contact and refund boundaries. Voluntary family duty can be canceled; a funded finite pantry order is not a free recurring supply. Existing older manors retain their actual services without duplicate starter actors or invented grants. Owned residence/personally owned recovered goods can pass under the selected estate contract; communal fixtures, staff employment, rank and private knowledge do not automatically do so. An inherited packed shelter needs its actual native kit, and unfinished material recovery uses the existing abandonment policy. No dynasty/source-canon simulation is implied.

Fortunes/obligations are derived from actual household/livelihood owners, not another stored ledger or duplicate life authority. The primed neglect fixture is not a naturally played long starvation; old-age/awakening duration and higher trust tiers remain source-test-only where stated. Recorded resentment/trust currently lacking behavior readers is not implemented social consequence. Purse rank is an observable coins-held proxy, not general status/power. Gift money settles in its transaction while the trust slice is saved later: retain that exact technical gap instead of implying one atomic durable social settlement. Routines run only in their supported residence/player-work conditions; no broader autonomous absence entitlement follows.

Later source/publication/adoption addenda supersede their own earlier pending/uncommitted labels, preserving separate bundle/snapshot identities and optional assets. Those old installed receipts are not today's live app or process state. Current AD42 makes household feel/taste review optional, while broader pacing, natural acquisition, new clocks and unexercised technical behavior retain actual limits. No private save, hidden talent truth, runtime or current installation was inspected or changed here.
